steps.title: Shuffle & Determine First Player
text: Shuffle your deck. Flip a coin — the winner decides who goes first.
Flip a coin. The winner chooses to go first or second.

steps.title: Draw Opening Hand
text: Each player draws 7 cards from the top of their deck as their starting hand.
Both players draw the top 7 cards of their deck simultaneously. Keep your hand hidden from your opponent.

steps.title: Place Basic Pokemon
text: Place 1 Basic Pokemon face-down as your Active Pokemon, then place up to 5 more face-down on your Bench.

If you have no Basic Pokemon in your hand, you must take a mulligan: reveal your hand, shuffle it back into your deck, and draw 7 new cards. Your opponent may draw 1 extra card for each mulligan you take.
After drawing a hand with at least 1 Basic Pokemon, place one face-down in the Active Spot. You may optionally place up to 5 more Basic Pokemon face-down on your Bench.
Tip: Placing multiple Basic Pokemon on your Bench gives you backup options if your Active Pokemon is Knocked Out.

steps.title: Set Prize Cards
text: Take the top 6 cards of your deck and place them face-down to the side as your Prize cards.
Place exactly 6 cards from the top of your deck face-down in your Prize card area. Neither player may look at Prize cards during the game.
Each time you Knock Out an opponent's Pokemon, you take 1 of your Prize cards and add it to your hand.

steps.title: Flip & Begin
text: Both players flip all their face-down Pokemon face up and the game begins.
Reveal your Active and Benched Pokemon by flipping them face up. The first player's turn then begins.

steps.title: Deck — Main Deck
text: Exactly 60 cards — no more, no less.
You may have at most 4 copies of any card with the same name. Basic Energy cards are unlimited.
Your deck must contain at least 1 Basic Pokemon.

steps.title: Deck — Special Card Limits
text: You may have only 1 total ACE SPEC card per deck.
You may have only 1 Radiant Pokemon per deck.
You may have only 1 copy of each Prism Star card per deck.
Your play area is arranged as shown above. Each player has their own zones within a shared in-play area.
**The Zones**
bullets: **1. Active Spot** — The front row. Only the Active Pokemon can attack. You must always have exactly 1 Active Pokemon.
**2. Bench** — Back row for Benched Pokemon (up to 5). They can use Abilities but cannot attack. Damage to Benched Pokemon ignores Weakness and Resistance.
**3. Deck** — 60-card draw pile, face-down. Neither player may look at or rearrange either deck.
**4. Discard Pile** — Used and Knocked Out cards go here face-up. Anyone can look through it at any time.
**5. Prize Cards** — 6 face-down cards set aside during setup. Take 1 when you KO an opponent's Pokemon. First to take all 6 wins.
**6. Lost Zone** — A special out-of-play zone. Cards sent here cannot be recovered for the rest of the game.
**7. Stadium (shared)** — Between both Active Spots. Only 1 Stadium can be in play at a time.

text: **Damage Counters**
Each damage counter represents 10 damage. A Pokemon is Knocked Out when its total damage equals or exceeds its HP.
